verification.reason: A fresh official BEA iTable-core fetch identified product 1 as International Transactions (ITA), table-list key 62 as Table 5.1 with A, QSA, and QNSA views, and returned the exact selected 2026 Q1 QSA line 18 row. The response prints the table title, million-dollar unit, seasonally adjusted basis, period, row label, and value 18,511. The concept and current public retrieval path are exact. A separate exact /api/data probe using BEA's public sample identity was rejected as inactive and is retained only as negative transport evidence, not as verification. The retrospective successful fetch does not prove release-time custody, and the existing bea-release implementation is hard-coded to a GDP release page and NIPA Table 5.3.5 response shape, so admission requires an ITA sibling variant rather than unchanged reuse.

adapterDisposition.requiredWork: Add a sibling ITA path under the BEA official-release family. It must authenticate the U.S. International Transactions and Investment Position release page rather than a GDP advance-release page; fetch the app-62 prompt catalog and derive the requested year's current ListKey instead of assuming Filter_#1=1 forever; seal product 1, table-list 62, QSA, and line 18; parse TheTableFlexibleIipIta's nested TD-cell response rather than the NIPA Data_Rows shape; verify the displayed year, quarter, unit, seasonal basis, line number, and normalized row label; and preserve complete release-page and table-response bytes with release-day refusal behavior. No unrelated new source family is required, but the current NIPA parser cannot be reused unchanged.

parseNotes: The line filter returns ancestor lines 11 and 17 as well as selected line 18. Select the exact line-number and normalized Personal transfers label pair; never read the parent secondary-income or private-transfer totals.
Filter_#1 values are prompt-catalog ListKeys, not literal years. The fetched catalog maps key 1 to 2026, but a resolver must derive and verify this mapping for each run.
Filter_#2=1 means quarterly seasonally adjusted. Do not substitute annual or quarterly not-seasonally-adjusted values.
The table already prints millions of dollars, so the normalized usd_millions value uses an identity transform; do not apply the NIPA family's 0.001 conversion.
The Wave-1 ALFRED rejection remains evidence that no exact history mirror is available. Do not attach IEAMSIRN or BOPGR as if either were the same series.
Do not relabel this broad personal-transfer flow as the section 4475 taxable base, tax collections, exempt transfers, section 36C claims, or an effect of H.R. 5595.
